pros: Instant reward redemption with an extensive selection of airline and hotel partners via HSBC Singapore mobile app.
pros: Accelerated earn rate: up to 2.4 miles for your spending.
pros: No conversion fee for air miles or hotel points until 31 January 2025.
pros: Complimentary travel insurance coverage (including COVID-19) and 4x complimentary airport lounge visits for primary cardholders and guests of primary cardholders.
pros: Receive complimentary access to ENTERTAINER with HSBC app, with over 1,000 1-for-1 deals on dining, lifestyle and travel worldwide.

extra.description: The HSBC TravelOne Credit Card is a reliable travel credit card that allows you to earn 1.2 miles per dollar on local spend and 2.4 miles per dollar on overseas spend. It's biggest selling point is the number of transfer partners - featuring 9 airlines and 3 hotel partners - the most in Singapore. It also provides 4 complimentary lounge visits per year, ideal for those well travelled.
